shipped_synthetic_file.note: data/seeds/synthetic_cases.jsonl was generated against a larger graph; most of its diseases and phenotypes do not exist in the current graph, so it cannot be used to score it.

gnn.measured_when_enabled_on_synthetic: Not evaluated - the GNN could not be loaded in this environment (checkpoint present but load_han failed, e.g. torch_geometric not installed); enabling it falls back to the deterministic path, so no GNN-specific number exists.

caveats: synthetic_400 is regenerated from the current graph (seed 42) using the same disease annotations the scorer uses: circular, an upper bound, not clinical accuracy.
The documented 'hits@5 0.92 on 400 cases' (docs/TRAINING_RECIPES.md) was measured on a larger graph and cannot be reproduced on this checkout's graph (see shipped_synthetic_file).
curated_seed_12 has 12 cases: far too few for confidence intervals; indicative only.
No real patient outcome data exists: real-world accuracy is NOT evaluated.
Phrases are exact HPO labels from the seed cases: this measures lookup of canonical names, not free-text or Hinglish robustness.

clinical_ner.label: SYMPTOM exact-span match
caveats: The seed set is also the lexicon/training source: this is NOT a held-out evaluation and overstates generalisation.
One verified trio (n=1): a smoke test and determinism check, NOT an accuracy estimate. Sensitivity/specificity: not evaluated - no labelled variant benchmark.

digital_twin.reason: Rule/derivation based; scenario outputs are recomputations of the diagnosis and variant engines. No outcome ground truth: not evaluated.

reproductive_risk.reason: Deterministic Mendelian/Bayesian arithmetic validated by unit tests against known ratios; no outcome data: not evaluated.

pharmacogenomics.reason: CPIC rule lookup (deterministic); concordance with a lab gold standard unavailable: not evaluated.

hpo_embeddings.reason: Optional sentence embedding re-ranker; disabled in this run (GENOMIND_EMBED_MODEL=none), so not evaluated.

kg_models.reason: Knowledge-graph build is ETL, not a trained model; graph size reported by /platform/status.
